                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n18a:Td34,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The correct answer is Option 2.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ସଠିକ୍ ଉତ୍ତର ହେଉଛି ଚୁମ୍ବକୀୟ କ୍ଷେତ୍ର।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ମୁଖ୍ୟ ବିଷୟବସ୍ତୁ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • ସ୍ରୋତ-ବାହକ ପରିବାହକ ଚାରିପଟେ ସୃଷ୍ଟି ହୋଇଥିବା ଚୁମ୍ବକୀୟ କ୍ଷେତ୍ରର ଦିଗ ନିର୍ଣ୍ଣୟ କରିବା ପାଇଁ ଡାହାଣ ହାତ ବୃଦ୍ଧାଙ୍ଗୁଳି ନିୟମ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରାଯାଏ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • ନିୟମ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, ଯଦି ଡାହାଣ ହାତର ବୃଦ୍ଧାଙ୍ଗୁଳି ବିଦ୍ୟୁତ୍ ସ୍ରୋତର ଦିଗକୁ ଦର୍ଶାଏ, ତେବେ ପରିବାହକ ଚାରିପଟେ ବୁଲିଥିବା ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଚୁମ୍ବକୀୟ କ୍ଷେତ୍ର ରେଖାର ଦିଗକୁ ସୂଚାଏ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • ଏହି ନିୟମ ସିଧା ପରିବାହକ ଉପରେ ପ୍ରଯୁଜ୍ୟ ଏବଂ ପରିବାହକ ଚାରିପଟେ ବୃତ୍ତାକାର ଚୁମ୍ବକୀୟ କ୍ଷେତ୍ର ରେଖାଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ କଳ୍ପନା କରିବାରେ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ କରେ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • ଚୁମ୍ବକୀୟ କ୍ଷେତ୍ରର ଦିଗ ଆଙ୍ଗୁଠିଗୁଡ଼ିକର ବିନ୍ୟାସ ଦ୍ୱାରା ନିର୍ଣ୍ଣୟ କରାଯାଏ, ଯାହା ତାର ଚାରିପଟେ ଏକକେନ୍ଦ୍ରୀୟ ବୃତ୍ତ ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରେ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ଅତିରିକ୍ତ ସୂଚନା

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • ପ୍ରୟୋଗ\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • ଚୁମ୍ବକୀୟ କ୍ଷେତ୍ରର ଦିଗ ବୁଝିବା ଇଲେକ୍ଟ୍ରୋମ୍ୟାଗ୍ନେଟ୍, ଇଲେକ୍ଟ୍ରିକ୍ ମୋଟର ଏବଂ ଜେନେରେଟର ଡିଜାଇନ୍ କରିବାରେ ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • ଏହା ବୈଦ୍ୟୁତିକ ଚୁମ୍ବକୀୟ ତରଙ୍ଗ ଏବଂ ସେମାନଙ୍କର ପ୍ରସାରଣ ଅଧ୍ୟୟନରେ ମଧ୍ୟ ଅତ୍ୟାବଶ୍ୟକ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n18a:Td34,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The correct answer is Option 2.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Magnetic field lines inside a current-carrying solenoid are uniform and parallel to each other along the axis of the solenoid.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The field inside the solenoid is the same at all points and is considered to be uniform in strength.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The field lines do not intersect each other; they run parallel to the axis and are evenly spaced, indicating a uniform field.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • The statement that the field lines are "ellipsoidal and intersect with each other" is incorrect, as magnetic field lines never cross each other.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Current-Carrying Solenoid:\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • A solenoid is a coil of wire designed to create a magnetic field when an electric current passes through it.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • When current flows through the solenoid, it generates a magnetic field similar to that of a bar magnet, with distinct north and south poles.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Magnetic Field Lines:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Magnetic field lines are a visual representation of the magnetic field, showing the direction and strength of the field.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • They always form closed loops, emerging from the north pole and entering the south pole of a magnet.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Properties of Magnetic Field Lines:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Magnetic field lines never intersect; if they did, it would imply multiple directions for the magnetic field at a single point, which is impossible.The density of the field lines indicates the strength of the magnetic field; closer lines represent a stronger field.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\tThe correct answer is Option 2.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • When a soft iron bar is introduced inside a current-carrying solenoid, the magnetic field inside the solenoid increases significantly.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Soft iron has high magnetic permeability, which means it enhances the magnetic field by becoming magnetized itself.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The magnetic domains in the soft iron align with the magnetic field created by the solenoid, thus amplifying the overall magnetic field.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • This phenomenon is used in electromagnets to create strong magnetic fields by inserting a core of soft iron inside the solenoid.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Magnetic Permeability:\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • It is a measure of how easily a material can become magnetized or how well it can support the formation of a magnetic field within itself.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Materials with high magnetic permeability, like soft iron, are used to enhance magnetic fields in various applications.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Electromagnet:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • An electromagnet is formed by passing an electric current through a coil of wire wrapped around a magnetic core (usually soft iron).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The current generates a magnetic field, which magnetizes the core, thus creating a strong magnetic field.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Solenoid:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • A solenoid is a cylindrical coil of wire acting as a magnet when carrying electric current.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Solenoids are widely used in various devices where control of a magnetic field is needed, such as in relays, valves, and inductors.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Magnetic Domains:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Magnetic domains are regions within a material where the magnetic moments of atoms are aligned with each other.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • In the presence of an external magnetic field, these domains align in the direction of the field, increasing the material's overall magnetic strength.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ", "hn": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Key Points 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • जब धारावाही परिनालिका के अंदर नर्म लोहे की छड़ रखी जाती है, तो परिनालिका के अंदर चुंबकीय क्षेत्र काफी बढ़ जाता है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • नर्म लोहे में उच्च चुंबकीय पारगम्यता होती है, जिसका अर्थ है कि यह स्वयं चुम्बकित होकर चुंबकीय क्षेत्र को बढ़ाता है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • नर्म लोहे में चुंबकीय डोमेन परिनालिका द्वारा उत्पन्न चुंबकीय क्षेत्र के साथ संरेखित होते हैं, इस प्रकार समग्र चुंबकीय क्षेत्र को बढ़ाते हैं।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • इस परिघटना का उपयोग विद्युत चुम्बकों में सोलेनोइड के अंदर नरम लोहे का एक कोर डालकर मजबूत चुंबकीय क्षेत्र बनाने के लिए किया जाता है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Additional Information 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • సరైన సమాధానం ఆప్షన్ 2.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ముఖ్య విషయాలు

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • విద్యుత్ ప్రవహించే సోలెనాయిడ్ లోపల మృదువైన ఇనుప కడ్డీని ప్రవేశపెట్టినప్పుడు, సోలెనాయిడ్ లోపలి అయస్కాంత క్షేత్రం గణనీయంగా పెరుగుతుంది.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • మృదువైన ఇనుము అధిక అయస్కాంత పారగమ్యతను కలిగి ఉంటుంది, అంటే అది స్వయంగా అయస్కాంతీకరించడం ద్వారా అయస్కాంత క్షేత్రాన్ని పెంచుతుంది.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • మృదువైన ఇనుములోని అయస్కాంత డొమైన్‌లు సోలెనాయిడ్ ద్వారా సృష్టించబడిన అయస్కాంత క్షేత్రంతో అమరికలో ఉంటాయి, తద్వారా మొత్తం అయస్కాంత క్షేత్రాన్ని విస్తరిస్తుంది.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
